name: Park-Camping Iller
beschreibung: The Park-Camping Iller is located in Aitrach and lies in an attractive scenic setting on the edge of the Tiroler Alpen. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes and tents, arranged on level, partly shaded areas. The gentle hilly landscape with views of the surrounding mountain ranges shapes the atmosphere of the grounds. Nearby there are hiking trails for various difficulty levels, leading through meadows, forests and along river floodplains. For winter sports enthusiasts, several ski areas in the region are reachable and easy to get to by vehicle. Amenities include sanitary facilities, electrical connections and supply options for campers. The immediate surroundings offer access to the natural landscape with meadows, floodplains and near-natural river sections. Guests find here a quiet starting point for activities in the mountains and surrounding area.
